verses.text: Long ago God spoke to our ancestors through the prophets, many times and in many different ways.
But in these last days he has spoken to us through his Son. God chose him to own all things, and through him God made the universe.

The Son shows God's glory and is the exact picture of who God is. He holds all things together by his powerful word. After he made us clean from our sins, he sat down at the right hand of God, the Majesty in heaven.
So he became much greater than the angels, just as the name God gave him is far greater than theirs.
God never said to any angel, "You are my Son. Today I have become your Father." Or again, "I will be his Father, and he will be my Son."
And when God brings his firstborn Son into the world, he says, "Let all of God's angels worship him."
About the angels God says, "He makes his angels like winds, and his servants like flames of fire."
But about the Son he says, "Your throne, O God, lasts forever and ever. You rule your kingdom with what is right.
You have loved what is right and hated what is evil. That is why God, your God, has chosen you and poured the oil of joy on you, more than on anyone else."
He also says, "Lord, in the beginning you laid the foundations of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.
They will pass away, but you will remain. They will all wear out like old clothes.
You will roll them up like a coat, and they will be changed like clothes. But you stay the same, and your years will never end."
God never said to any angel, "Sit at my right hand until I put your enemies under your feet."
Angels are all spirits who serve God. He sends them to help those who will receive salvation.
